# Backtracking over marker-aligning translations; constrain every marker to be matched by a different piece.
from collections import Counter

def gen_candidates(name, placed):
  # translations aligning >=1 marker of name with a marker from any placed part
  existing=set()
  for other,ot in placed.items():
    existing |= shiftset(parts[other]['M'],ot)
  cand=shift_candidates_to_markers(name,existing)
  out=[]
  for t in cand:
    if not inbounds(parts[name],t): continue
    if not colors_nonoverlap(name,t,placed): continue
    # scoring: matches existing marker positions
    score=len(shiftset(parts[name]['M'],t)&existing)
    out.append((score,t))
  # best overlaps first, then moderate positions/ compact cluster
  def sortkey(item):
    score,t=item
    # total area/span approx across occupied elements after placement
    cells=[]
    for n,ot in placed.items(): cells += list(shiftset(parts[n]['C']|parts[n]['M'],ot))
    cells += list(shiftset(parts[name]['C']|parts[name]['M'],t))
    span=(max(r for r,c in cells)-min(r for r,c in cells)+1)*(max(c for r,c in cells)-min(c for r,c in cells)+1)
    return (-score,span,t)
  return sorted(out,key=sortkey)

def marker_coverage_possible(placed, remaining):
  # each currently singly occupied coordinate must be coverable by at least one remaining part
  cnt=Counter()
  for n,t in placed.items():
    for x in shiftset(parts[n]['M'],t): cnt[x]+=1
  singles=[x for x,v in cnt.items() if v==1]
  if not singles: return True
  # candidate translation for each remaining part to cover any single; check bounds and collisions
  for x in singles:
    can=False
    for n in remaining:
      for m in parts[n]['M']:
        t=(x[0]-m[0],x[1]-m[1])
        if inbounds(parts[n],t) and colors_nonoverlap(n,t,placed):
          can=True;break
      if can:break
    if not can:return False
  return True
